cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Admit It Wasn’t Fair
cards.instruction: Get an apology that acknowledges how the rules, comparison, or outcome worked against you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before congratulating the winner, apologise for starting me behind the shed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Yes. I spent the first ten seconds finding the race.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely opening. Add 'and that was unfair to you.'
